Multiplier for the 40x daily wage cost. Default 40 means cost = 40 × total daily wage of the prisoner group.
If true, accelerated recruitment will recruit prisoners even if vanilla conformity has not been reached yet. If false, it will only recruit currently recruitable quantities.

Only attempt recruitment while you are inside a town or village.
Automatically dismiss troops below a certain tier when your party is near capacity.
Troops of this tier or lower are candidates for auto-dismissal when over capacity.
Dismiss troops that are very heavily wounded (high wounded count relative to stack).
If a stack has more than this % wounded, consider it for dismissal (when enabled).
